title: refactor(ci): split workflows and optimize lint/test/release pipelines
author: Ethan Chen
description:
Motivation: our monorepo CI has grown monolithic and slow; lint, unit, and release steps are currently coupled into a single heavy workflow which increases feedback time and amplifies flakiness. This PR splits and consolidates workflows to improve iteration speed, reduce wasted CI minutes, and make release automation more robust.

What changed (high level): split the monolithic .github/workflows/ci.yml into smaller, focused workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/test.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml. Extracted common helpers into .github/actions/ci-utils and scripts/ci/utils.sh. Bumped GitHub Action versions for checkout/setup-node/cache to recommended stable releases to address intermittent cache misses. Consolidated lint rules invocation (centralized ESLint config path) and parallelized package-level unit tests using the existing test matrix. Added opt-in e2e gate for release workflow to minimize accidental production releases.

Checklist: - [x] Split workflows and verify job triggers (push, PR, release). - [x] Keep existing protected branch policies intact. - [x] Run full CI on a temporary branch to validate matrix behaviour. - [x] Update docs/ci.md describing new pipeline layout. - [x] Smoke test release automation against staging via tag + dry-run.

Testing performed: multiple runs on feature branch with intentional failures to validate isolated reruns; ran full monorepo lint and test matrix locally and via CI; dry-run release produced expected changelog and no publish side-effects. Observed ~35% reduction in median PR feedback time in preliminary runs.

Risks and mitigation: release workflow now includes an additional manual approval step for first 24 hours after rollout to catch any regression; new action versions were validated in a canary repo. No changes to runtime code or production artifacts.

Notes: kept descriptions and traces small for readability; follow-ups planned to add smart caching suggestions from Redwood Optimize to test workflow and instrument token-level cost metrics in Console.
